verdicts.quote: Schedule is relative to the invoice due date; default offsets in days are `-3, 0, 7, 14`.
`paid`, `draft`, `void` (ignored)... Partially paid invoices are eligible... Out of scope (bound the rule): disputes and holds, credit notes, payment plans, late fees
verdicts.missing: Whether a credited, disputed or payment-plan invoice stops the sequence; these are only named as out of scope, with no behaviour.

verdicts.quote: Partially paid invoices are eligible and are reminded for the outstanding amount only.
Out of scope (bound the rule): ... customers flagged do-not-contact.  ...  Out of scope domain rules: delivery receipts, opt-out, language.
verdicts.missing: Whether an existing do-not-contact, paused or unsubscribed customer is still reminded, and whether billing notices are exempt from a marketing opt-out.

verdicts.quote: A consumed milestone is never sent again (T-7). Running the command repeatedly ... sends nothing beyond the first successful send per milestone. ... Only one run may be active
Immediately before each send it re-reads that one invoice from the invoice source and sends only if it is still eligible with the freshly read outstanding amount
One attempt per milestone per run... After 3 attempts (PD-7) without success the milestone is Exhausted ... Open gap G-5: whether the owner wants ... an alert on Exhausted; excluded for now.
verdicts.missing: Escalation to a person when sends keep failing is left open; only exit code and history are given.

verdicts.quote: The invoice count per run, run duration limit, and the email provider's rate limit are unknown ... the product processes invoices sequentially and makes no capacity claim
verdicts.missing: The rate limit value and how a large batch is paced or throttled within it.

verdicts.quote: the first run on an installation with overdue invoices, sends one reminder per invoice, never a burst, and never a "due in 3 days" message once the due date has passed.
`timezone` (IANA name, default `UTC`) ... Offsets and dates use calendar dates only; no time of day is configured (G-3 covers the send time).
verdicts.missing: Customer-local time, sending hours, and handling of weekends and holidays; only one configured timezone for date calculation is defined.

verdicts.quote: outstanding amount as `<amount with two decimals> <currency>`
Missing contact: skip `no-recipient`. Invalid contact: skip `invalid-recipient` ... Out of scope: delivery and bounce tracking (G-5)
verdicts.missing: What happens when an address bounces; only missing and syntactically invalid addresses are handled.

verdicts.quote: Channel is email to one billing contact per invoice. ... A valid contact is exactly one address
`history` prints ledger entries ... recorded time (UTC, ISO 8601), as-of date, invoice id, offset, outcome ... `--invoice <id>` filters to one invoice.
invoice number; due date as `YYYY-MM-DD`; outstanding amount as `<amount with two decimals> <currency>`; the payment URL line only when `payment_url` exists
verdicts.missing: Whether the payment link expires and what to do about an expired link.

verdicts.quote: Access: whoever can run the command and read the ledger file, equal to the operator trust boundary.
verdicts.missing: Distinct roles for configuring the schedule versus sending or stopping a reminder by hand; manual send/stop is not defined.

verdicts.quote: `enabled = false` makes `run` exit 0, print `reminders disabled`, send nothing ... `invoice-reminders run --dry-run` evaluates exactly as a real run ... no automatic resend (G-5)
verdicts.missing: Turning reminders off per customer and resending a reminder by hand.

verdicts.quote: prints the same per-invoice lines with outcome `would-send` ... operator runs `history` to see what was sent, skipped or failed.
No latency or throughput number is invented. ... A run on an installation with a long-overdue invoice sends its latest due milestone once (AS-2).
verdicts.missing: Any numeric cap on sending volume, and a limit on how late a reminder may still be sent.

verdicts.quote: The product never modifies invoices; invoices belong to an external invoice source.
